contract.consistency: One authoritative writer per persistent dataset; verify fresh reads of committed rows, native lock behavior and the declared API boundary. No distributed, HA or multi-process concurrent DuckDB writer claim.

contract.idempotency: No automatic mutation retries; unique IDs are application-generated, not assumed to be server-side deduplicated. A timeout or closed connection is not proof that no mutation applied.

correctness_gates: Validate every old/new row in ID order against the independent canonical CSV oracle, including earlier ACKs
Persist an fsynced external intent/ACK witness outside the failed storage
Prove old-owner exit before replacement; verify native replay and readable rebuilt state
Test snapshot plus journal tail, a second snapshot/restart, and no duplicate replay
Keep writers/readers live through operational faults; saved-table tests alone do not meet this gate
Distinguish torn final frames from corruption inside intact frames; retain original evidence and native diagnostics
contract.performance_gate: Correctness/recovery first. Three fresh-process trials with matched input, query results, durability and resource budgets; report actual monotonic durations, trial spread, native storage/compression and per-phase resource costs. OS-cold behavior requires an isolated owned environment or supported cache controls; never clear shared host caches.

records.cpu_utilization_scope: Cgroup CPU includes runtime, wrapper and accounting commands; denominator is Docker StartedAt to FinishedAt, parsed at microsecond resolution. CPU snapshot precedes the final accounting commands/exit, so their final CPU is not included. Driver uptime window has 10 ms resolution; per-query CPU and wall time are separate exact-clock samples.

block_io.scope: Whole-container kernel block-I/O accounting, including wrapper. Empty counters/cached reads do not establish zero physical host I/O; Docker Desktop file sharing can perform work outside this cgroup. Not logical engine bytes, device latency or queue depth.

sampled_resources.scope: Approximately 100 ms plus API/inspection overhead; arithmetic sample mean, not heap or time-weighted mean. Sampling can miss short peaks; use native cgroup memory.peak and process RSS too. Docker daemon/VM overhead excluded.

records.storage_sample_scope: Observed verification mount files, including native state, WAL/temp files present at sampling and CSV exports. Peaks can be missed; raced paths are incomplete observations. Source fixture and container root filesystem are separate.

cases.native_compression_scope: DuckDB storage_info reports codecs; Rayforce explicitly requests compressed durable column saves, with native files retained. File footprints include metadata; no pure codec ratio is inferred from a whole-database size. CSV gzip is a separate measured layer.

host_controller.scope: Host controller and Docker CLI children. Export gzip/hash costs overlap this total; native engine/container metrics are separate.

cases.disk_scope: Owned directory began empty. Per-process samples retain native state, observable WAL/temp files and CSV exports separately. Final file sizes are settled after graceful close/reopen; sampling can miss shorter peaks and records rename races.
cases.raw_native_file_samples_scope: Non-atomic directory observations can miss peaks or race renames; raw per-file values and known races remain in each record. Export witnesses are excluded from the native-file sum.

unrun: live journal recovery under independent writers/readers
SIGKILL, torn journal and interior corruption
